description: Attio is a CRM with a REST API, App SDK and MCP server for developers.
auth_notes: Workspace admins generate scoped access tokens (API keys) in Workspace settings; tokens do not expire. MCP server uses OAuth login instead.
gate_detail: API keys are available on all plans, but only workspace admins can create them. No paid plan or review is stated. No sandbox is described.
api_scope: REST API plus App SDK documented, with a webhook reference and endpoint reference pages; scoped tokens read, create or update workspace data.
mcp_notes: Official Attio MCP hosted on attio.com; OAuth login with an Attio account, available on all plans.
blocker_detail: Token creation requires a workspace admin, but no payment, review or partnership gate is stated.

evidence.quote: API keys allow you to connect external tools and services to your workspace with secure, scoped access.
In order to generate an API key for your workspace, you must be an admin.
Tokens do not expire, but can be deleted at any time.
Connect your GTM stack with the REST API, App SDK, or Attio MCP.
Add https://mcp.attio.com/mcp as a remote MCP server and complete the OAuth authentication when prompted.

uncertainties: REST authentication guide text is truncated in the sources, so Bearer header usage is not confirmed.
Webhook support inferred only from a 'Webhook reference' section tag.
